issue.title: ACE refresh pulse file lands two directories too deep under day-sharded artifact layout

task_type_fields.impact: ArtifactWatcher (src/sase/ace/tui/actions/event_refresh/_artifact_paths.py) is non-recursive and only watches direct children of <project>/artifacts/, per the plan_propose_handler.py comment describing this exact pulse mechanism. Since agents created via the current default (create_artifacts_directory always day-shards ace-run per tests/test_agent_artifact_layout.py), the pulse write silently misses the watched directory for effectively every new agent's shell handoff and plan-propose handoff, so the Agents tab misses the fast async nudge and falls back to waiting up to FULL_SANITY_REFRESH_SECONDS to reflect status changes like PLAN. src/sase/shells/settlement.py:204 shows the correct pattern already in use elsewhere: sase_projects_dir() / project_name / 'artifacts' / '.ace_refresh_pulse', computed from project_name rather than positional path arithmetic.
task_type_fields.repro: Both sites build the ACE inotify pulse path as Path(artifacts_dir).parents[1] / '.ace_refresh_pulse', which is correct only for the legacy flat layout (<project>/artifacts/ace-run/<timestamp>: parents[1] == <project>/artifacts). The default day-sharded layout (DAY_SHARDED_LAYOUT_VERSION in src/sase/core/agent_artifact_paths.py) nests two more levels: <project>/artifacts/ace-run/<YYYYMM>/<DD>/<timestamp>. For a sharded artifacts_dir, parents[1] resolves to <project>/artifacts/ace-run/<YYYYMM> instead of <project>/artifacts. Repro: call _touch_agent_artifacts_refresh_pulse(artifacts_dir) (or trigger the plan-propose handoff) with a sharded artifacts_dir and observe the pulse file written under .../ace-run/<YYYYMM>/ rather than directly under .../artifacts/.
